verdict.rationale: Polar's remote MCP server uses OAuth to authorize agent access rather than requiring a copied API key, and documents that this avoids leaking a full-privilege secret into the agent (polar-supp-mcp, polar-probe-5 confirming a live OAuth-gated endpoint). However, there is no documentation of configurable scopes/permission levels (e.g., read-only, resource-limited) for these credentials, nor of a separate least-privilege API key system for non-MCP agent use. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission granularity documentation, evidence of restricting an agent to specific resources/actions, and any independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.
